subject: a compact jellyfish woven from wire and thread
pose: bell tilted with short tentacles curling inward
art_direction: 铜丝与蓝色细线织成水母冠，短触须卷成小环，透空结构和温柔点眼保持可读轮廓。
composition: one original central subject with a clear silhouette and circular-crop safe focal point
creative_direction: Weave a compact jellyfish bell from thin copper wire ribs crossed by cobalt textile thread. The bell tilts slightly, and six short tentacles curl inward as small loops rather than hanging in long strands. Two tiny dark beads tucked beneath the rim suggest a serene curious character without making it cartoonish. Keep the structure partly transparent so the crossed wire and thread remain visible. Use a pale sand background with one soft shadow, and light the copper from the side to separate warm metal from cool fiber. The inward-curling tentacles maintain a clean central silhouette within a circular crop. No ocean setting, bubbles, lettering, or additional creatures.
style_inspiration: Entirely original text-only concept, no IP characters, copied artwork, celebrity likeness or named artist imitation.
